'''Thanium''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located within the [[Thanium system/Legends|Thanium system]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. It was absorbed into [[Xim's empire|Xim's Empire]] as [[Xim/Legends|he]] expanded his borders from the [[Kingdom of Cron]].<ref name="Atlas" />
